opportunities.title: APEX Awards
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Lead applicant must be an exceptional independent researcher with a permanent or fixed‑term position, based in a UK university or not‑for‑profit research organisation, with teaching and administrative duties. Co‑applicants must be independent researchers from a different Academy remit, also based in a UK university or not‑for‑profit.
opportunities.summary: Cross‑disciplinary award for established researchers to pursue interdisciplinary, curiosity‑driven research across the social sciences, humanities, engineering and natural sciences.

opportunities.title: SHAPE Involve and Engage
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Any researcher based in the UK, across career stages, who has prior public‑engagement experience; previous recipients cannot re‑apply.
opportunities.summary: Funding up to £8,000 for public‑engagement projects with GLAM or performing‑arts organisations, encouraging innovative ways to engage the public with humanities and social sciences research.

opportunities.title: The Alexander von Humboldt Foundation and The British Academy Knowledge Frontiers Symposium 2027
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early‑career researchers in the humanities and social sciences affiliated with UK or German research institutions.
opportunities.summary: Three‑day symposium on ‘Humans and Nature: More resilient towards the future’; travel, accommodation and visa costs covered for selected early‑career scholars.

opportunities.title: Postdoctoral Fellowships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early‑career researchers in the humanities or social sciences based at a UK university or recognised research organisation, UK/EU nationals, with a doctorate awarded between 1 Apr 2024 and 1 Apr 2027, and not holding a permanent academic post.
opportunities.summary: Three‑year fellowships to enable independent research leading to a significant publishable output, funded by the Department for Science, Innovation & Technology.

opportunities.title: Talent Development Awards 2026-27
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Lead applicants must be UK residents with a long‑term appointment at a UK HEI or independent research organisation, working in the humanities or social sciences; independent researchers without institutional affiliation are not eligible.
opportunities.summary: Awards up to £10,000 to develop new quantitative, data‑science, digital‑humanities, language or other methodological skills, supporting interdisciplinary or skill‑building projects.

opportunities.title: International Interdisciplinary Research Projects 2027
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Principal Investigator must be a UK‑based researcher in humanities or social sciences, postdoctoral or above, with at least 20 % FTE on the award; co‑applicants must be overseas and collaboration must be interdisciplinary.
opportunities.summary: Two‑year interdisciplinary projects on mobilities, led by UK researchers with international partners, covering any SHAPE or STEM discipline but grounded in humanities/social sciences.

opportunities.title: Global Innovation Fellowships: The German Council on Foreign Relations (DGAP) 2026-27
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK‑based early‑career or mid‑career researchers in the humanities and social sciences.
opportunities.summary: One‑year fellowships hosted at the German Council on Foreign Relations in Berlin, focusing on security, Indo‑European relations, technology/AI, or European strategy‑making, with up to £150,000 funding.

opportunities.title: Additional Needs

amount.raw: up to £4,000 (higher amounts possible with justification)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Current British Academy award‑holders or applicants planning to apply for a British Academy award within the next six months.
opportunities.summary: Funding to support additional needs such as equipment, caring costs, or assistance for disabled researchers, up to £4,000 per request, on a rolling basis.
